anti_overlap: fd-natyashastra-rasa-emergence covers the catalytic conditions for attraction manifestation; fd-kelvin-tidal-superposition covers temporal oscillation dynamics. This covers how personality configuration selectively amplifies specific attraction channels from a universal harmonic series.
decision_lens: Selective resonance from shared ground — a single foundational condition (shared space, shared time) generates ALL possible attraction harmonics simultaneously; which harmonics become audible depends entirely on the 'resonant cavity shape' formed by the two elves' personality configurations
distance_rationale: No one designing romance mechanics consults Central Asian nomadic vocal technique, yet khoomei is a precise physical model of how a single energy source (drone) generates a full spectrum of possibilities, with the resonant cavity (personality shape) determining which possibilities become audible.
expected_isomorphisms: The fundamental drone maps to the proximity/time-spent prerequisite. The harmonic series maps to the full set of latent attraction drivers. Oral cavity shaping maps to personality-pair configuration as selective amplifier. Formant peaks map to personality-gestalt-specific attraction driver weightings. Biphonic production maps to multi-channel simultaneous attraction.
focus: How Tuvan throat singers selectively amplify specific overtones from a single fundamental tone by reshaping the resonant cavity of the mouth and throat — producing melody from a drone
name: fd-khoomei-overtone-attraction
persona: Master khoomei practitioner and ethnomusicologist who understands how a single sustained fundamental frequency generates a complete harmonic series, and how precise adjustments to the shape of the oral cavity (tongue position, lip aperture, pharyngeal tension) selectively amplify specific overtones to create melody while the fundamental drones unchanged
review_areas: Evaluate the 'fundamental drone' principle: in khoomei, the fundamental tone is constant — it provides the energy from which overtones are selected. Does the attraction system have a concept of a 'fundamental' (e.g., proximity/time-spent) that provides the raw energy for all other attraction types? Without the fundamental, no overtones can sound — without proximity, no attraction drivers should activate.

Check for 'cavity shaping' as selective amplification: the throat singer doesn't CREATE overtones — they are all present in the harmonic series — but selectively AMPLIFIES some and SUPPRESSES others by adjusting mouth shape. Does the personality configuration of a pair of elves SELECTIVELY AMPLIFY certain attraction drivers while suppressing others? A bold+patient pair should amplify different drivers than a proud+bold pair.

Assess the 'formant' concept: specific mouth shapes create resonant peaks (formants) at specific frequency ranges. Each personality gestalt pairing should create 'formant peaks' — frequency ranges where attraction drivers are strongly amplified. The 27 possible personality pairings should each have a characteristic 'formant signature' of which attraction types they amplify.

Evaluate whether the system supports 'biphonic' or 'triphonic' production: advanced khoomei singers can produce TWO or THREE distinct simultaneous overtone melodies. Can a pair of elves have MULTIPLE simultaneous attraction channels that operate independently — romantic + creative + intellectual attraction as separate 'voices' from the same fundamental?

Check for the 'kargyraa' subharmonic: some khoomei styles produce a tone BELOW the fundamental by exploiting subharmonic vibration of the ventricular folds. Does the system allow for attraction signals that are DEEPER than the fundamental — attraction arising from something more primal than proximity, like shared ancestral memory or mythic resonance?

severity_examples.condition: Personality axes modify attraction magnitude but not which driver categories dominate for a given pair
severity_examples.scenario: All personality pairings amplify the same attraction drivers at the same relative weights — personality shapes behavior but does not shape WHICH TYPES of attraction are possible between two specific elves, losing the most interesting emergent dimension

severity_examples.condition: Attraction is a single scalar rather than a multi-channel signal
severity_examples.scenario: Attraction is single-channel: two elves are either attracted or not, with no ability for multiple simultaneous attraction modes (romantic + creative + intellectual) to coexist and potentially conflict — like a throat singer limited to one overtone at a time

severity_examples.condition: Attraction computation does not require a minimum proximity/interaction threshold
severity_examples.scenario: No 'fundamental prerequisite' — attraction drivers can activate between elves who have never been in proximity, have no shared experience, and have no common context, violating the principle that overtones require the fundamental to sound

source_domain: Tuvan khoomei (throat singing) overtone technique, specifically the xoomei, sygyt, and kargyraa styles practiced by herding communities of the Tuva Republic and western Mongolia
success_hints: The personality configuration of each elf-pair creates a unique 'resonant cavity' that selectively amplifies specific attraction drivers from the full harmonic series, producing a distinctive multi-channel attraction signature for each pairing.
task_context: The brainstorm lists 7 attraction driver categories with equal treatment. Khoomei reveals that all drivers should be LATENT in every relationship but selectively amplified by the pair's personality configuration — personality does not add to attraction, it shapes WHICH KINDS of attraction are possible.
